basic_profile.bio: I'm a hobbyist tinkerer from Portland, Oregon, who loves experimenting with gadgets and kitchen appliances. By day, I'm a mechanical engineer working on sustainable energy projects. I'm a big fan of anime, especially 'Neon Genesis Evangelion,' and I enjoy exploring the depths of art history in my free time. My evenings are usually spent online, typically from 7 PM to midnight. I'm currently single and enjoy diving into complex video games like 'X4: Foundations' on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering and a self-taught background in DIY projects, I have a solid understanding of both theoretical and practical aspects of mechanical systems. My curiosity often leads me to experiment with everyday items, like my popcorn kettle, to optimize their performance.
